QuestionStmt.S: Which from following functional groups has highest priority order for naming the poly functional compound?

Solution.S: According to IUPAC priority order for functional groups in polyfunctional compounds, the highest priority is given to groups like -COOH, -SO₃H, -COOR, -COCl, -CONH₂, -CN, -CHO, -OH, -NH₂, -C≡C-, -C=C-, etc. Among the given options, -CN (cyano group) is a derivative of carboxylic acid and has higher priority than -CONH₂ (amide), -C≡C- (alkyne), and -NH₂ (amine). Therefore, -CN has the highest priority, corresponding to option A.
